items:
This townhome on Inlet Beach provides an extraordinarily relaxing and beautiful private beach destination in a secluded location. Inlet beach is adjacent to Rosemary Beach yet peaceful and uncrowded. A large deck with chaise lounges, a table and chairs, and swing overlooks the white sand beach and emerald gulf coast. A fully equipped, renovated kitchen opens to a living area with indoor dining table so you may dine-in during your stay on the beach. Master bedroom upstairs with a queen size bed, en suite bathroom, and a balcony with chairs and awesome views of beach, gulf, and the stars. The secondary bedroom upstairs has another queen size bed, en suite bathroom, and balcony. The third bedroom on the main level has two twin beds and en suite bathroom.

To the west you may bike the neighborhood streets and/or walk the beach to Rosemary Beach for shopping, dining, concerts, and festivals. You may bike or drive scenic 30-A to nearby Alys, Seaside, Watercolor, and Grayton Beach.

To the east you may walk along the beach to Phillips Inlet in Camp Helen State Park which offers nature trails, bird watching, and wildlife observation.

The Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport (ECP) makes our beach home accessible to the world via Southwest Airlines et al.

There are beach chairs, umbrellas, body boards, and beach toys that you may use and steward for the next guests.
